description: agent_teams/messager inprocess pub-sub + p2p — Python openjiuwen/agent_teams/messager/inprocess.py vs Rust ah-contracts/src/messager.rs
note: Language-neutral. Outcome: per case, 'deliveries' = ordered list of messages the handler received (with sender_id stamping applied by publish). Cases marked known_divergence document real semantic gaps found by this differential and are reported but non-fatal.

cases.name: cross_instance_shared_bus
cases.note: Python _Bus is process-global (all InProcessMessager share it), Rust InProcessMessager owns a per-instance bus; teammate->leader fan-out therefore differs. Rust must adopt a shared/global bus to reach parity.
